L69: ## Support policy
L70: 
L71: 【12†#】
L72: 
L73: The Dart team supports only the latest, stable version of the Dart SDK. When a new major or minor version is released, older versions are no longer supported. For example, if `3.7.x` is the latest release, it is supported until `3.8.0` or `4.0.0` is released, whichever comes first.
L74: The Dart team provides fixes to critical issues and security problems as needed through patch releases but only for the currently supported version. For example, if `3.7.0` is the latest stable release, a fix to a vulnerability might be issued in a `3.7.1` patch release.
L75: 
L76: On average, the Dart team ships a new stable release every 3 months. Patch releases to the currently supported version are shipped as needed.
L77: This policy helps ensure Dart developers have access to a stable and reliable platform that continues to evolve with new features and improvements.

L46: The Dart team supports only the latest stable release of the SDK. For full details on the SDK release lifecycle and supported versions, check out the 【18†SDK support policy】.

L69: ## Choose an installation option

L92: ## Install the Dart SDK
L93: 
L94: 【13†#】
L95: 
L96: To install the Dart SDK, use the appropriate package manager for your development platform.

L98: To upgrade the Dart SDK, run the same command to install the Dart SDK from your package manager.
L99: 
L100: You have two options to install the Dart SDK on Windows:

L103:   * Use 【35†Chocolatey】.

L105: ### Install using winget

L112:     `
L113: ### Install using Chocolatey

L115: 【35†#】

L198: ### Install using a Linux package manager

L206: ### Install using the `apt-get` package manager
L207: 
L208: 【48†#】

L210: To install Dart with `apt-get`, perform the following steps. You need steps 1 to 3 only for the first install.

L216:   2. Download and add the Google Linux GPG public key.

L218:     `$ wget -qO- https://dl-ssl.google.com/linux/linux_signing_key.pub \
L219:       | sudo gpg --dearmor -o /usr/share/keyrings/dart.gpg
L220:     `

L222:   3. Add the Dart package repository to your Linux system.

L224:     `$ echo 'deb [signed-by=/usr/share/keyrings/dart.gpg arch=amd64] https://storage.googleapis.com/download.dartlang.org/linux/debian stable main' \
L225:       | sudo tee /etc/apt/sources.list.d/dart_stable.list
L226:     `
